scenario.note: At least 60% of overmanned workers must be in year 2; this is enforced via a logical rule that at least one of the conditions holds, where the overmanned workforce in year 2 is at least 60% of the total overmanned workforce across years.
The short-time working limit in year 1 is capped at 25% of the limit in year 3.
Short-time working in year 2 is required to be at least three times that in year 1.
The rule ensures that skilled workers account for at least 50% of total recruits across all years and skill levels.
At most 10% of the total short-time workers in the unskilled level are allowed.
Year 3 redundancy is capped at 15% of total redundancies across all years.
The overmanned workforce in semi-skilled must be at least 50% of that in unskilled, enforced via a logical rule on the overmanned measure by skill level.
The semi-skilled workforce must account for at least 50% of all overmanned workers across all years.
The short-time working limit is capped at 40% of unskilled workers. Redundancies in year 3 are at most 25% of those in year 1.
Short-time working limit for skilled workers is capped at 5% of total short-time workers across all skill levels.
Short-time working limit for semi-skilled workers is capped at 5% of total short-time workers across all skill levels.
At least 60% of total recruits must be in year 3, expressed as a relative rule on the recruit measure over all years.
Year 1 short-time working is capped at 25% of the total short-time workforce across all years.
